Every run is saved as one JSON file in the history folder (runs_dir in llmention.yaml, .llmention/runs by default).

Related commands:
  llmention report

Usage:
  llmention history [command]

Available Commands:
  export      Copy a saved run to a file
  list        List saved runs, newest first

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for history

Global Flags:
      --config string   Path to the config file
      --dry-run         Preview changes without performing them
      --json            Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi         Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color        Disable color in human output
      --no-pager        Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt       Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet           Suppress non-essential output

Use "llmention history [command] --help" for more information about a command.
